headline: Affle to Acquire Perion Network in $420 Million Takeover Deal
summary: Affle has agreed to acquire Perion Network in a deal valuing the company at an implied equity value of approximately $420 million. Perion shareholders will receive $11.70 per share.
why: Perion Network is a Nasdaq-listed digital advertising technology company. The acquisition scales Affle's consumer conversion adtech business into developed markets.

impacts.name: Perion Network
impacts.why: Perion shares typically adjust toward the agreed cash acquisition price of $11.70 per share.
